| # List of BSW API available for the untrusted partitions without any restrictions {#list-of-bsw-api-available-for-the-untrusted-partitions-without-any-restrictions-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The application software component in an untrusted partition is only allowed to call APIs listed in the table below without any restrictions and callback handling.

 

  BSW API                    Documentation
  -------------------------- --------------------------
  bds_dsm_getFIdPermission   bds_dsm_getFIdPermission
  bds_inI_get                bds_inI_get
  bds_inDig_get              bds_inDig_get
  bds_inR_get                bds_inR_get
  bds_inU_get                bds_inU_get
  bds_outClcU_get            bds_outClcI_get
  bds_outDig_get             bds_outDig_get
  bds_outPwm_get             bds_outPwm_get
